items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: He looked like a white man. In fact, that's how my mother looked.

ctx.x: When did you... that was Victor Koloss. Yeah, Koloss. Is that what you pronounce the name? Yes, Koloss. He looked just like a Frenchman, too.
He looked like a white man. In fact, that's how my mother looked.
I was only in there home, and it was about a half an hour I had to visit. Well, my mother looked just like him.
